detail: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited, a renewable energy company, filed a disclosure document with NSE on 24 June 2026 under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is triggered when a person (or group) acquires shares or voting rights exceeding the threshold specified under the regulations. The identity of the acquirer, number of shares, consideration, and whether this is a full takeover bid or partial stake acquisition could not be corroborated from publicly available news as of the filing date.
